title: reAlpha | Names Russell Sinclair Head of Product | 2026 | reAlpha Investor Relations: Nasdaq AIRE Market Growth | reAlpha
summary: reAlpha appoints Russell Sinclair as Head of Product, bringing leadership experience from Prevu, Microsoft and StreetEasy to drive product innovation.
body_markdown:
*Veteran of Microsoft, StreetEasy, Prevu and House IQ to guide product strategy across reAlpha’s real estate, mortgage, and title technology offerings*


**DUBLIN, OH – November 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)** – reAlpha Tech Corp. (Nasdaq: AIRE) (“reAlpha” or the “Company”), an AI-powered real estate technology company, today announced the recent hiring of Russell Sinclair as Head of Product. Based in New York, Mr. Sinclair will lead product strategy and management across the Company’s platform.


Mr. Sinclair joins reAlpha from House IQ, where he served as Head of Product. Previously, he spent more than seven years at Prevu, which reAlpha acquired in November 2025, joining in 2018 as Vice President of Product and becoming Chief Product Officer in 2021, overseeing both product and engineering. In that role, he led development of Prevu’s consumer-facing and agent-facing home-buying solutions. His deep familiarity with that platform and its team positions him to execute on reAlpha’s vision from day one.


“Russell is a product leader who earns the trust of homebuyers, real estate professionals and engineers alike. Having worked alongside him at Prevu, I’ve seen how he turns a vision into products people rely on, and that skill is what we need as AI reshapes our industry,” said Thomas Kutzman, Chief Financial Officer of reAlpha.


Mr. Sinclair brings more than two decades of experience across enterprise and consumer technology. Beyond Prevu and House IQ, he held product leadership roles at StreetEasy, a Zillow Group company focused on the New York City real estate market, and he spent several years in product roles at Microsoft. With experience spanning enterprise technology and consumer real estate companies, Mr. Sinclair is well-positioned to bring both rigor and domain expertise to reAlpha’s goal of delivering a more cohesive product across its businesses.


“At reAlpha, we have an opportunity to use AI to rethink how people navigate the homebuying process, from the search, through financing, to closing the transaction. I’m excited to drive product innovation that connects these experiences and makes buying a home simpler and more seamless for our customers,” said Mr. Sinclair.


**About reAlpha Tech Corp.**


reAlpha Tech Corp. (Nasdaq: AIRE) is an AI-powered real estate technology company that aims to transform the multi-trillion-dollar U.S. real estate services market. reAlpha is developing an end-to-end platform that streamlines real estate transactions through integrated brokerage, mortgage, and title services. With a strategic, acquisition-driven growth model and proprietary AI infrastructure, reAlpha is building a vertically integrated ecosystem designed to deliver a simpler, smarter, and more affordable path to homeownership. For more information, visit[www.realpha.com](https://www.realpha.com/) .
